HiranoImbensRidder2003 treats estimated propensities for ATE under regular overlap; Dorn2025 treats weak-overlap orthogonal means, not this singular quantile-score likelihood functional.

novelty_flags.label: comparator_promise_table; related_work; literature_map; seed details
novelty_flags.one_line: These repeatedly call Proposition 8.2 the finite-dimensional Lévy characterization, but the inspected arXiv source makes Proposition 8.2 the deterministic quadratic-process limit; Proposition 8.3 supplies the Lévy limit.

soundness_flags.label: ass:tail-marks
soundness_flags.one_line: The conditional expectation given pi_a(X)=t is defined only up to F_a^pi-null sets, yet the claimed uniform t-downarrow-0 modulus quantifies pointwise in t; require a specified Borel regular conditional-score version satisfying that modulus.

soundness_flags.label: thm:sharp-transfer
soundness_flags.one_line: The escape construction returns a perturbed learner, while E_{a,n} and D_{a,n} are defined for the unperturbed learner; state explicitly whether both quantities are recomputed for the perturbed learner and use distinct notation if so.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2506.18215v1, 23 June 2025; this is the publicly inspectable archival version at the cited arXiv record, while the core's claimed August 2026 revision is not available there.
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 18-20, §8.1: Proposition 8.2 and the following Proposition 8.3; proof of Theorem 3.1.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Proposition 8.2 proves convergence of the quadratic Knight remainder to u^2 g_Y(q(tau))/2. Proposition 8.3 gives the finite-dimensional infinitely divisible/Lévy score limit, and the proof then combines Propositions 8.2 and 8.3.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Correct every Avella-Medina–Davis–Samorodnitsky locator: reserve Proposition 8.2 for the quadratic remainder and cite Proposition 8.3 for the Lévy characterization; also identify the exact revised manuscript version if one exists.

Make ass:tail-marks a Borel-version condition and introduce separate symbols for the escape-perturbed learner, its relative tail error, and its interior discrepancy before stating the necessity theorem.

Add the optional local minimax lower bound for the signed boundary likelihood functional, or a direct lower-bound corollary showing the displayed learner rate cannot be improved over the stated power-link Hölder class.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two well-posedness defects and the Avella-Medina proposition mischaracterization, then retain this angle as a field-tier learned-propensity weak-overlap QTE project.
